First, determine UTC offsets for the given date (January 16, 1890).  
Asia/Shanghai historically used UTC+8 (since 1901, but before that local mean time; for this problem, assume UTC+8).  
US/Pacific historically used UTC-8 (standard time).  

Source time: 14:00 (UTC+8)  
UTC = 14:00 − 8 = 06:00 UTC.  
Target (US/Pacific) = 06:00 UTC − 8 = 22:00 previous day (January 15, 1890).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 22:00
